gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8483 names gear boxes and other speed changers
Section XVI note 2(a): parts that are goods of a heading of chapter 84 (8483 is not in the excluded list) are classified in their own heading, so 8432 parts provision is not reached
GRI 6: 8483.40 gear boxes and speed changers; 8483.40.50 other than pulp/paper use; fixed ratio assumed

other speed changers; used only if not fixed ratio

missing_facts: Whether the gearbox is fixed ratio or variable ratio (changes statistical suffix)
classification.rationale: A gearbox assembly is a gear box of heading 8483; under Section XVI note 2(a) it stays in 8483 rather than 8432 parts. Fixed ratio is assumed for a spreader drive, giving 8483.40.50.10. The suffix or heading versus 8432.90 could be contested.
